traits.text: Perithecia immersed to partly exposed in the subiculum, dark amber to reddish-brown, appearing as minute pimples over the infected surface

traits.raw: ⚪🟠🟤 Spore mass hyaline; mature infected surface ochre to brick-red

traits.text: Fungicolous parasite mainly on Lactarius species, especially orange-milkcaps; covers undeveloped gills; summer to autumn

traits.label: Edibility

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Fruiting layer thin, spreading across substantial portions or nearly all of the host hymenium

traits.label: Dimensions
traits.text: Perithecia ~300–470 × 170–360 µm

traits.label: Description
traits.text: Parasitized host becomes firm, deformed and partially mummified

traits.label: Chemical reactions
traits.text: KOH subiculum negative; perithecia becoming yellowish

traits.text: Ascospores fusiform to lanceolate/naviculate, finely verrucose, aseptate, ~15–27 × 3.5–5.5 µm, with conspicuous acute apiculi at both ends; asci cylindrical, 8-spored, ~90–150 × 4–8 µm; anamorph forms subglobose aseptate conidia ~5–6.5 × 4.5–6 µm
